AuthorityMutationBoundary: AuthorityMutation is measured from immediately before workload mutation through ApplyAuthority, including ChunkPublication commit and prepared source creation.
NetworkAndRemoteReplicationBoundary: NetworkAndRemoteReplication begins after ApplyAuthority and accumulates the existing server-owned scheduling, server Network, and server proof-application work.
AuthorityThroughNetworkAndRemoteReplicat: AuthorityThroughNetworkAndRemoteReplication is one direct elapsed interval per tick from immediately before authoritative mutation through the endpoint after the final remote transport/application/proof pump. It includes the interleaved client-side transport and semantic work required to reach that endpoint and is never reconstructed from phase durations or aggregate percentiles.
